verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a broad API surface: REST, CLI and MCP (heygen-docs-3, heygen-docs-4); prompt-to-video with avatar, voice and style control (heygen-docs-10, heygen-docs-33); Video Agent storyboard review and scene-level revisions (heygen-docs-11, heygen-docs-12); photo and cinematic avatars (heygen-docs-13, heygen-docs-18); LiveAvatar (heygen-docs-14); account and credit info (heygen-docs-9); and batch requests (heygen-docs-1). No evidence claims UI–API parity, and several UI features shown only on pricing and product pages (brand kit/asset library, translation script editing, SCORM export, workspaces and roles) have no documented API equivalent. No public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths (heygen-probe-2). Missing for 10: an explicit parity claim or feature-by-feature mapping, documented API endpoints for brand kit, translation script editing, SCORM export and workspace/role management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
